record.title: Preserve boot collection failures with deterministic runner controls
record.intent: Make early guest collection failures produce precise statuses final health attempts teardown and a complete evidence index.
requirements: Preserve the aborted frozen run and its unknown transport cause; do not claim the stock loader hypothesis was tested.

Bound changes to the outer runner; record mandatory boot command statuses and phases, skip stock admission when boot collection fails, and preserve result cleanup final health attempts and index on early runtime exit without adaptive command retry.

Exercise the actual finalization logic using deterministic host controls for successful collection getprop failure after output subsequent collection failure and final health failure; no guest launch in these controls and no writable links to original evidence.

Review the resulting mutation and freeze updated harness inputs while leaving stock APK native code observer binary register responses loader checkpoints and payload expectations unchanged; commit and push before the next guest attempt.
acceptance: A checked failure-preserving runner and deterministic controls are committed and pushed.
